items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a childhood friend whose name is Morrison Bishop.

ctx.x: What made you -- why reeds? Why clarinet?

That’s an interesting story I think. I have a childhood friend whose name is Morrison Bishop. We’re the same age. We lived close to each other. We were looking at a daily newspaper one day, and we saw an ad in the paper by Wurlitzer Music Store for music lessons. There was a picture of a clarinet in the ad. On different days they might have a trumpet, or a piano, or a trombone. This day they had a clarinet. So my friend Morris said, “Hey, look at this. I think I’ll take up the clarinet.” I said, “I think I will…
Do you remember how much it cost in those days?
